scope: Primary deployed slot accounting path: DemoWalletStore.expansion and real /api/demo-wallet/expansion HTTP routes. This report checks integer accounting and accepted-round recovery, not RTP qualification or production player data.

validation.typecheck: pass: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --strict --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions server-tests/cosmic-wallet-audit.test.ts

startChecks: Exact stake times selected cost is debited once for all 26 stakes and 4 modes.
Active bonus returnedUnits stays zero and the wallet holds the debit.
Full 10000 times base stake reservation covers every active paid round.
New accepted sessions save probability profile 3.

echoCap.secondFrame: Echo raw payout exceeds cap, final accumulated payout equals exactly 10000 base stakes, reserve releases and one win entry remains.
echoCap.concurrentDistinctOperationIds: Two distinct operation IDs race at the same revision. Exactly one succeeds, the other rejects, one credit remains, and a new wallet instance replays the winning receipt without drawing.

coverage.transactionRollback: Injected final-credit INSERT failure leaves balance, bonus revision, reserve and operation receipt unchanged. After removing failure, two concurrent retries settle once.
coverage.historicalRecovery: Constructed accepted base histories whose trigger entropy is below both profile entry thresholds are labeled profile 2 or absent legacy profile. PostgreSQL connections are closed and reopened. Accepted history, spent amount and label persist; start replay does not draw or debit; all 12 free spins then finish once.
httpChecks: Missing authentication returns 401; cookie/account mismatch returns 401; another authenticated account cannot access the session and returns 404 without drawing.
Card rules header 1 rejects a new start with 409 before any draw or debit.
Accepted current-rule sessions can continue and replay under header 1 or 2. Headers cannot reprice a saved round.
Changed stake or mode on start replay and a second start while active return 409.
Additional stakeUnits, state or returnedUnits in continuation input return 400.
Two concurrent identical moves return the same authoritative session, including one replay.
A different operation ID with stale revision returns 409 without drawing.
Only terminal accumulated payout is credited; duplicate terminal replay cannot credit again.
coverage.zeroBalanceContinuations: All three constructed natural bonus series complete while the available wallet balance is exactly zero until final settlement.

limitations: The 104-case grid checks initial debit and reservation. It does not claim 104 separately completed bonus simulations.
Twelve selected constructed full rounds cover boundaries, natural bonus lengths, echo capping, rollback, history and every mode through HTTP.
Injected random samples and Mulberry32 seeds exercise accounting paths; they do not estimate RTP or test production RNG quality.
Historical profile cases are constructed test snapshots, not downloaded historical production rounds.
Persisted-state semantic mutation coverage is a separate engine audit. This suite verifies that HTTP clients cannot submit settlement state or change accepted stake/mode.
No production environment, balances, player histories, game mathematics or qualification proofs were changed.
